title: fagara sprucei
intro: Fagara sprucei, commonly known as Szechuan pepper, is a plant native to China that belongs to the Rutaceae family. It has been traditionally used in medicine due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and alleviating pain. The therapeutic actions of Fagara sprucei include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
